stage.unbound_world.raiders_dawn.summary: A pillager raid threatens the land. Defeat its evoker to earn your first taste of undying power.
stage.unbound_world.echoes.summary: The seas grow restless. Depths once calm now hide a guardian of ancient treasure.
stage.unbound_world.sculk_dread.summary: Something ancient listens in the deep dark. Every step echoes closer to its wrath.
stage.unbound_world.hellfire.summary: The Nether's fury boils over. Its undying tyrant demands a reckoning.
stage.unbound_world.void_call.summary: Beyond the stars, the End awakens. Its ancient sentinel guards what should not be taken.
boss.unbound_world.evoker.location: Leads pillager raids that assault villages with an Ominous Bottle or a raid horn.
boss.unbound_world.pillager.location: Marches with raiding parties and patrols, crossbow in hand.
boss.unbound_world.vindicator.location: Guards Woodland Mansions and marches with raiding parties.
boss.unbound_world.ravager.location: Charges alongside raiding parties, ridden by pillager captains.
boss.unbound_world.vex.location: Summoned by an evoker, flitting erratically through walls.
boss.unbound_world.illusioner.location: A rare, elusive raider that conjures illusions and blinding magic.
boss.unbound_world.elder_guardian.locati: Found in ocean monuments, guarding the depths alongside its guardian kin.
boss.unbound_world.guardian.location: Patrols ocean monuments, striking with a laser gaze.
boss.unbound_world.warden.location: Emerges from the deepest sculk shrieker alarms within an Ancient City.
boss.unbound_world.wither.location: Summoned in the Nether wastes by those bold enough to defy its return.
boss.unbound_world.blaze.location: Guards Nether Fortresses, hurling fireballs from above.
boss.unbound_world.ghast.location: Drifts through Nether skies, raining explosive fireballs.
boss.unbound_world.magma_cube.location: Bounces through the Nether's basalt deltas and fortresses.
boss.unbound_world.wither_skeleton.locat: Stalks the dark fortress halls of the Nether.
boss.unbound_world.piglin_brute.location: Guards Bastion Remnants deep within the Nether.
boss.unbound_world.hoglin.location: Roams the crimson forests of the Nether in aggressive herds.
boss.unbound_world.zoglin.location: A corrupted hoglin, mindlessly hostile wherever it wanders.
boss.unbound_world.ender_dragon.location: Circles the central obsidian pillars of the End dimension.
boss.unbound_world.shulker.location: Hides within End City towers, camouflaged against the purpur blocks.
